on_screen_text.text: Melania Trump has declined to comment on Trump's East Wing demolition.
Maintaining the East Wing, including its holiday decorations, has historically been the First Lady's responsibility.

She complains in a frustrated tone about having to work on Christmas decorations, saying, "who gives a f*** about Christmas stuff and decoration?" She then laments that when she does work on Christmas planning, she is criticized about "the children that they were separated," and exclaims, "Give me a f***ing break."

manipulation_or_satire: A 'before' photo shows the White House interior decorated for Christmas, while an 'after' photo shows an unrelated demolition site. On-screen text labels these 'east wing before trump' and 'east wing after trump' to create the false visual claim that the Trump administration demolished part of the White House.

intended_effect: To generate negative sentiment towards Melania and Donald Trump by portraying them as destructive, uncaring, and hypocritical.
